Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Would you like to join a company that puts people at the heart of its concerns? We are waiting for you! Since 2007, Extia, an IT consulting company, has been offering a unique approach in its field by combining well-being at work and performance.
 Our philosophy at Extia is “First who, then what", so let's go for it!
 🚀First who? 
 Collaborative , you work effectively in cross-functional teams and enjoy sharing knowledge with others.
 Proactive , you take ownership of your work and drive technical initiatives from design to delivery.
 Quality-driven , you are well organized and continuously look for ways to improve code quality, processes, and the overall platform.
 This position is hybrid, requiring 5 days/month in the Bucharest office. 
 🚀Then what? 
 We are looking for a Java Developer to join our fintech client and contribute to the development and evolution of a large-scale payment platform. You will play a key role in designing and implementing new features, driving technical excellence, mentoring team members, and collaborating within an Agile environment to deliver high-quality software.
 Responsibilities: 
Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend features and platform enhancements.
Take technical ownership of new functionalities, from design through implementation and delivery.
Contribute to the architecture and continuous technical evolution of the platform.
Ensure code quality by following development standards, best practices, and clean coding principles.
Develop and maintain RESTful microservices using modern Java technologies.
Write automated tests and promote TDD and BDD practices.
Produce clear technical documentation and actively share knowledge within the team.
Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and best practices.
Troubleshoot and resolve production and development issues efficiently.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment to deliver high-quality solutions on time.
 Technical Skills: 
Strong commercial experience with Java 17+ , Spring Boot , Hibernate , and SQL .
Experience building RESTful APIs and microservices .
Solid understanding of object-oriented design , TDD/BDD , and Agile development practices.
Familiarity with DevOps principles and CI/CD environments.
Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
Experience with AWS and cloud-native applications.
 Nice to Have: 
Knowledge of clean code , SOLID principles , and design patterns .
Experience with testing frameworks ( JUnit, Cucumber, Selenium/WebDriver ) and development tools ( Git, Maven, Jenkins ).
Familiarity with Unix/Linux , shell scripting, XML/JSON , and large-scale database environments.
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the "Who" and represent the "What"? Apply and let's talk!
